hints: The mass appears in both the kinetic-energy relation and the momentum relation; write both equations before substituting numbers.
Eliminate v by making it the subject of p = mv, then substitute into Eₖ = ½mv².
walkthrough: The initial kinetic energy is Eₖ = ½mv² and the initial momentum is p = mv.
From the momentum relation, v = p/m. Substitute this into the kinetic-energy relation: Eₖ = ½m(p/m)² = p²/(2m).
Substitute p = 0.37 kg m s⁻¹ and Eₖ = 0.30 J: m = 0.37²/(2 × 0.30) = 0.228... kg.
The mass of block X is 0.23 kg.

Uses the momentum relation p = mv.
Eliminates speed or uses an equivalent valid route to obtain a mass of 0.23 kg.

hints: Choose right as positive, then give every stated momentum a sign from its direction.
Conserve the total signed momentum before and after the collision; the requested answer is the magnitude of Y's final momentum.
walkthrough: Take right as positive. Initially, block X has momentum +0.37 kg m s⁻¹ and block Y has momentum −0.65 kg m s⁻¹, so the total is −0.28 kg m s⁻¹.
After the collision, X has momentum −0.13 kg m s⁻¹. Let Y's leftward momentum magnitude be p, so its signed momentum is −p.
Conservation of momentum gives −0.28 = −0.13 − p, so p = 0.15 kg m s⁻¹.
The required magnitude of Y's momentum is 0.15 kg m s⁻¹. No major formula is required because all momentum values are supplied and only the conservation balance is used.

ai_rubric.observable: Conserves signed momentum and obtains a final momentum magnitude for block Y of 0.15 kg m s⁻¹.

hints: Use the change in momentum of either block during the collision; block X reverses direction, so its signed momentum change includes both magnitudes.
Relate average force to momentum change divided by contact time, then rearrange for the time.
walkthrough: Take right as positive. Block X changes from +0.37 kg m s⁻¹ before collision to −0.13 kg m s⁻¹ after collision.
Its momentum change is −0.13 − 0.37 = −0.50 kg m s⁻¹, with magnitude 0.50 kg m s⁻¹.
For the average force magnitude, F = |Δp|/Δt, so Δt = |Δp|/F = 0.50/7.7 s.
The contact time is 0.0649... s, which rounds to 0.065 s.
